title: Portcullis app template manifest
description: Schema for <app-id>/manifest.yaml. The Hub enforces the same rules and skips templates that fail (integration contracts §3). Rules that need the compose file or the filesystem live in tests/validate.py.

name.description: Display name shown in the Hub.

description.description: One-line description of what the app does.

icon.description: Unicode emoji for the app card, e.g. "\U0001F4CA".

category.description: Catalog category (lowercase, e.g. monitoring, media, productivity, security, networking, ai, devops, finance, vpn, remote-access, public).

settings.description: User-configurable settings shown in the Hub; each key becomes a per-app .env key.

ports.description: Host port bindings. The Hub writes them into the per-app compose override; compose.yml must not publish these itself.

env.description: Per-app environment variables. Entries with generate: random are generated by the Hub and written to the per-app .env.

keycloak_clients.description: OIDC clients registered in Keycloak when the app is enabled. Required for native-oidc.

urls.description: Links shown in the Hub. {{DOMAIN}} is replaced with PORTCULLIS_DOMAIN.

noControlChars.description: No control characters (Hub hasControlChars): the value is spliced into .env files.

serviceName.description: A service in the template's compose.yml.

method.description: native-oidc: app talks OIDC to Keycloak itself. forward-auth: oauth2-proxy + group-gate in front, app has its own (or no) login. header-auth: forward-auth plus the app trusts X-Forwarded-User from Traefik. mtls: client certificate at the TLS layer. custom: app-specific (e.g. plex.tv). public: no authentication.

group_access.description: group-gate restricts the app's subdomain to access_group.

group_admin.description: The app maps admin_group to its admin role.

identity_headers.description: Request headers a header-auth app reads the user from (e.g. X-Forwarded-User). Required for header-auth apps with public_access: the Hub strips them, their underscore forms and the core identity headers on public paths.

admin_paths.description: Path prefixes that additionally require admin_group (group-gate path_groups, contracts §4). Only effective on routers that use portcullis-groups@docker. Segment-boundary prefix match: /admin matches /admin and /admin/x, not /administrator.

publicAccess.description: Public path exceptions (contracts §3): when on, the Hub adds a Traefik router for these paths WITHOUT forward-auth/group-gate, so anonymous visitors can use the app's share links. The app's own auth still applies. Only for forward-auth, header-auth and native-oidc apps. More rules (one {token}, broad prefixes, overlaps, token_pattern probes) live in tests/validate.py and the Hub.

enabled_by_default.description: Initial state of the Hub toggle until an admin chooses. Default false.

default_mode.description: listed: only shares whose tokens an admin lists in the Hub (needs a {token} path); all: every share. Default: listed if a path has {token}, else all.

token_pattern.description: Anchored regular expression (^...$) every listed share token must match; required iff a path has {token}. Must not accept '/', '.', '..', spaces, backticks, '$' or '%'.

credential_headers.description: Request headers besides Authorization / Proxy-Authorization the app logs a user in with (API keys, session tokens). Core's public guard refuses requests carrying one; the Hub also strips them.

credential_cookies.description: Cookies the app logs a user in with (session, remember-me). Core's public guard refuses requests carrying one (names normalised like PHP, raw and percent-decoded, case-insensitive).

credential_query.description: Query parameters the app logs a user in with (e.g. apiKey). Core's public guard refuses requests carrying one (names normalised like PHP, case-insensitive).

static_extensions.description: File extensions supporting paths may serve in addition to the defaults (avif css eot gif ico jpeg jpg js map mjs otf png svg ttf webp woff woff2). Never script extensions.

service.description: Compose service the public router targets. Default: the only service with HTTP routers.

prefix.description: Segment-boundary path prefix (/s matches /s and /s/..., not /sx). One whole segment may be {token}: listed mode opens it per listed share, all mode up to the segment before it. Not / itself, no wildcards, no '..', '%', '?', '#'.

supporting.description: Token-free path the share page needs: opened in both modes, and only for static files (dot-free directories, a file with a static extension) unless exact. Token-free paths without supporting are opened only in mode all.

exact.description: Opens only this exact path (no subpaths), for a single app route the share page needs. Needs justification; not with {token}. A broad-list path (e.g. /index.php, /api) still needs broad: true.

broad.description: Acknowledges a prefix or exact path on the broad list (e.g. /api, /index.php, bare *.php); needs justification. Only on broad-list paths.

bind.description: Default bind address; must be an IP address (Hub: net.ParseIP).

email_verified_claim.description: Default true. false: the Hub attaches the realm's email-unverified client scope (email claim, no email_verified) instead of email, for apps that refuse email_verified=false but accept it absent. The app must then not request the email scope.

src.description: Path relative to the template directory.
